title: orchestrate plugin config
description: Tuning knobs for the orchestrate router. The SessionStart hook, the /orchestrate router skill, and the /orchestrate-workflows companion all read this file so behavior stays consistent across entry points. Config is layered (deep-merged, first present wins per key): repo .claude/ overrides user ~/.claude/ overrides the shipped default.

autonomy.description: How autonomous the orchestrator is once it has classified the task and built a plan. propose = announce the workflow + plan and wait for OK (default); auto = run immediately; threshold = auto only when under the threshold limits, otherwise propose.

threshold.description: Limits used when autonomy=threshold. At or below these, fan out automatically; above either, propose first.

roles.description: Which model plays each role. Aliases (opus|sonnet|haiku|fable) or a full model ID. The orchestrator is the top tier — the running session and any peer instance it spawns for adversarial judging/verdicts. Swapping orchestrator to fable makes fable fully replace opus everywhere the top tier is used. builder implements and writes prose; scout does read-only research/search.

workflows.description: Which pre-curated workflows the router may select, and per-workflow fan-out caps. A disabled workflow is never routed to; the router falls back to the closest enabled workflow or asks.

escalation.description: Cascade behavior. When a scout (Haiku) returns thin or low-confidence output on a leg, re-run that one leg at the builder tier before giving up.

doctrine.description: How forcefully the SessionStart hook injects the delegation doctrine. off = no injection; standard = inject as guidance; strict = inject as a hard rule.

alwaysPassModelExplicitly.description: Instruct the orchestrator to pass the model parameter explicitly on every Agent call, working around the frontmatter model bug (anthropics/claude-code#44385).

maxParallel.description: Cap on parallel fan-out agents for this workflow. Guards against the over-fan-out failure mode (Anthropic multi-agent research: fan-out is ~15x the tokens of a single pass).
